playGuide: Bring a Spray Paint gear item with paint left. Open Tag Studio (Alt+G) and select the active mission.
Travel to each named street map. Mission paint canvases are placed automatically when a commission starts or you arrive. The GM can move or repair any marker from the Mission Board.
Target or right-click the paint spot, pick a tag, and roll Graft. The result becomes a visible, persistent graffiti decal.
A failed or poor-quality tag can be painted over with another charge. Only validated marks at the required quality complete objectives.
Mission rewards are automatic after every required painted surface (and any quality challenge) is completed.

Travel to each named street map. Mission paint canvases are placed automatically when a commission starts or you arrive. The GM can move or repair any marker from the Mission Board.
Target or right-click the paint spot, pick a tag, and roll Graft. The result becomes a visible, persistent graffiti decal.
A failed or poor-quality tag can be painted over with another charge. Only validated marks at the required quality complete objectives.
Mission rewards are automatic after every required painted surface (and any quality challenge) is completed.
